name: Shua's Daughter
title: Judah's Canaanite Wife
summary: Shua's daughter was a Canaanite woman whom Judah took as his wife. She bore him sons named Er, Onan, and Shelah. She is also called Bat-Shua.

keyEvents.title: Judah's Wife
keyEvents.description: Judah took the daughter of the Canaanite Shua as his wife, and she bore Er, Onan, and Shelah.
